---
title: "Chess Engines & The Modern Game"
---

## Did engines flatten the elite?

This project tests one hypothesis: widespread access to computer-assisted preparation has **narrowed the gap** between the world's best player and the rest of the top 20.

We look at three angles:

1. **Rating convergence** — FIDE Top 100 lists from 1967 to today
2. **Move accuracy** — Stockfish evaluations of ~600 World Championship games
3. **Elo prediction** — can a model trained on modern games explain more variance than one trained on pre-engine games?
